QuestInfo.name: Breakfast of Champions
QuestInfo.0: #p9120010# in Showa Town is working hard on developing a new dish for their breakfast menu. What could it be?
QuestInfo.1:
#b#p9120010##k is thinking of adding a fried egg to their breakfast menu. You were tasked with gathering #t4000188# x100 and #t1322027# x1. It sounds like you can get them by hunting #o9400006# and #o9400024# who live in #m800000301#. This balanced breakfast is counting on you!
 
#t4000188#   #b#c4000188# / 100#k 
#t1322027#   #b#c1322027# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the cooking supplies to #p9120010#, and they rushed off to start cooking. Hopefully with delicious results!

0.0: A growing adventurer like you needs a breakfast that packs a punch! Wouldn't you agree?

yes.0: I want to create a special new dish for my breakfast menu, but I don't have the necessary ingredients or cooking implement.
yes.1: There's a special dish I tried while traveling abroad that was absolutely unforgettable. If I'm going to replicate that taste, I'll need duck eggs.
yes.2: You'll find the flavor profile is completely different than chickens eggs. Substitution is not an option. Could you bring me #b#t4000188##k x100 for my special recipe?
yes.3: I'm sure 100 eggs should be enough to replicate that dish.
yes.4: Ah, of course I'm going to need a #b#t1322027##k. You can obtain them from #o9400006#s in the #m800000301#.
yes.5: Even an amateur chef knows that frying pan is the perfect implement for frying eggs.
yes.6: I won't rest until I have #b#t4000188##k x100 and #b#t1322027##k x1.
yes.7: I'm sure it won't be an easy task, but I'm counting on you!

no.0: Oh, you don't eat breakfast? Let me know when you've realized the error of your ways.

1.0: Apparently I'm an excellent judge of character. I didn't think you'd gather them this quickly!
1.1: With these, I'll have no trouble creating a mouthwatering fried egg!
1.2: Next time you visit, breakfast is on the house! Look forward to it.

item.0: I don't think you have everything I need. Make sure you have #b#t4000188##k x100 and #b#t1322027##k x1.
